title: Delegated access & role lifecycle — flows and wireframe notes
content:
Context:
- Goal: define UX for delegating permissions at org/team level and lifecycle for roles, service accounts, and API keys. Lightweight wireframes attached (sketches) and a set of acceptance criteria + telemetry requirements. This is a working doc — focused on edge cases we saw in CS and SRE requests.

Quick summary of constraints and design goals:
- Keep most common flows < 3 clicks from the org settings root.
- Make least-privilege the default (scoped templates, not full-org by default).
- Make auditability and rotation visible and easy (link to audit log, show last-rotated meta inline).
- Support delegated admin model: grant a user or team the right to create roles / service accounts without making them full Org Admin.

Wireframes referenced (inline sketches):
- wireframe-delegate-role-flow-v1.png (main flow)
- wireframe-service-account-creation-v2.png (with key scopes)
- wireframe-api-key-rotation-modal.png
- wireframe-audit-log-presets.png

Proposed flows (high level):
1) Delegate role creation (primary new flow)
   - Entry: Org settings -> Access -> "Delegate role creation" CTA (secondary under Roles table).
   - Modal: pick delegate (user or team) + scope (Org-level, Team-level, Model-access-only). Default: Team-level.
   - Template selection: dropdown of curated templates (ReadOnly, Deploy, Billing-View, Model-Serve). Each template shows brief bullets and a "customize" link.
   - Preview: show effective permissions (expanded) and impact analysis (which routes, which console pages, API endpoints) — link to generated rollout checklist.
   - Confirmation: require typed acknowledgement if template grants org-level or billing access.
   - Post: create role and create an audit entry; send ephemeral notification to delegates.

   Notes and edge cases:
   - If delegate is a team, also show list of members on hover and account owner contact.
   - If a grant overlaps with an existing role, show merge/recommendation: "you already have X; do you want to extend or create distinct role?"

2) Service account + API key flow (combined UX)
   - Entry: Team page -> Service accounts -> Create -> two-step wizard.
   - Step 1: name, description, attach roles (pick from role list or create inline via mini-delegate-flow).
   - Step 2: key options: single long-lived key (classic) OR short-lived JWT + rotation policy + KMS binding. Default selected: short-lived with automatic rotation every 30 days. Explain cost/operational tradeoffs inline.
   - After create: show immediate API key (only shown once) + copy button + link to store it in secrets manager (docs link). Also attach a "create rotation schedule" CTA.

   TODO: UI microcopy to explain one-time-only key visibility and recommended secret storage.

3) API key rotation modal (common action)
   - In Service Accounts list: each SA row has actions -> Rotate Key.
   - Modal presents options: create overlapping key (grace period) OR force-rotate (revoke old). Recommend overlapping for production. Show estimated window while keys are valid.
   - Provide quick checklist: update clients, notify owners, link to last 7 audit entries related to that service account.

4) Audit log view for access changes
   - Audit landing: filter presets for "Access grants", "Key events", "Role changes", "Delegations". Saving presets available.
   - Row detail: actor, target (user/team/service-account), before/after diff (humanized), links to implicated routes, and ability to create a rollback (if applicable) or revoke the role.
   - Deep links: every role/service-account/assignment should deep-link to the relevant audit-filtered query. Pattern: /console/audit?filter=actor:XXX;resource:role:YYY

Wireframe & UI details (notes):
- Roles table: show small badges for scope (Org/Team/Model) and a "safety rating" (low/medium/high) computed by static rules (e.g., grants billing OR full-org admin -> high).
- Where we prompt for typed confirmation: use the exact string pattern "CONFIRM GRANT TO [delegate]" to prevent accidental clicks.
- Inline policy preview: collapsible JSON view with a friendly bullet summary on top.
- Accessibility: all modals tabbable, role previews available as plaintext copyable policy, color-blind safe badges.

Acceptance criteria (what in_review needs to validate):
- Delegation modal prototype in Figma + clickable prototype for the happy path.
- Unit tests for the three guardrails: typed acknowledgement for org-level grants, overlapping role detection, and one-time API key SSR flow.
- Telemetry events emitted: role_delegated, service_account_created, api_key_issued, api_key_rotated, role_revoked, audit_view_preset_used.
- Audit entries for every create/update/delete with before/after snapshots retained for 90 days.

Telemetry / instrumentation (first-pass):
- role_delegated: {actor_id, delegate_id, template_id, scope, method:modal|api}, TTL: emit on success only.
- api_key_issued: {sa_id, key_type:one_time|short_lived|long_lived, rotation_policy}, redact key material.
- api_key_rotated: {sa_id, actor_id, rotation_method, overlap_seconds}.
(note: schema details to be worked with infra/events team)

Open questions / discussion items:
- Q1: Should delegates see the audit entries they create? (security teams may want to restrict). Proposal: delegates can see audit entries limited to resources they own or created — product/security to decide.
- Q2: Should we enforce mandatory short-lived keys for Dedicated/Private customers? Might be a sale blocker. Consider an enterprise toggle.
- Q3: How to model role inheritance vs composition? (flat list with parent pointer vs sets). Early preference: composition (roles as sets of permissions) to simplify previews.

Edge-case scenarios to test in usability sessions:
- A user tries to create a delegated role that accidentally grants billing.read + billing.write via two templates. Check UI that surfaces this merge.
- Rotating keys for a SA actively used by 100s of clients — test overlap guidance clarity.
- Re-assigning service account ownership when members leave org (transfer flow).

Next steps & owners:
- Design: Priya -> produce Figma prototype for delegate modal (due 2025-11-24).
- Backend: Alex -> API to create delegated roles + impact analysis endpoint (JIRA:INFR-3421). ETA 2025-12-08.
- Security: Sana -> define audit retention and visibility policy (confluence:CONSOLE-523-role-model).
- PM: Marcos -> consolidate feedback from CS + SRE before grooming session (2025-11-21 grooming).

Notes to reviewers (quick):
- Focus feedback on the mental model (delegate vs admin) and the rotation UX — we need to make safe behavior "the easy path".
- If you have specific audit queries you rely on today, paste examples here; we'll map them to the filter presets.

Choppy TODO list (for internal):
- [ ] Draft microcopy for confirmation modals & rotation modal.
- [ ] Add keyboard-only flow notes for modals.
- [ ] Prototype merge/recommendation copy when overlapping grants detected.
- [ ] Define telemetry field schema with infra events team.
- [ ] Create Figma file and link it in this doc.

References & prior art:
- AWS IAM (delegate patterns) — note: complexity should be deliberately lower.
- GCP Service Accounts (one-time key visibility behavior).
- Internal: existing roles model (confluence:CONSOLE-523-role-model).

End of doc.

(Hand-off: this is intentionally a mix of sketches/notes and action items — expect follow-ups and a Figma link soon.)
